notes.title: "Alice's World" Steam Page released, the girl hears "your" voice from in front of the screen
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/bcb8ac1e2aa0c4c98220fb152a0303ecce06e954.png[/img]
Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game.
The girl opens her eyes in a desolate world, and hears "your" voice from in front of the screen.
You can direct her actions, help her solve mysteries, evade dangers, and find a way to leave this place. Of course, you could also choose not to do so, or even worse, deliberately guide her to death... Just kidding, you surely wouldn't do that, right?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439560/Alices_World/
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/b49d52caa40ed999c4231937661499124b6de4ac.jpg[/img]
[h2]【Game Features】[/h2]
[list][*]There is no role-playing! You are yourself, sitting in front of the screen, guiding the in-game character.
[*]Explore the stories hidden behind the desolate world, unravel the truth layer by layer.
[*]Exquisite Japanese-style art and full voice acting bring an immersive experience.[/list]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/9e79f45938240209d61449759220516509a38062.jpg[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/4d1759dee13a21b06e099af803e9f7edc449b451.gif[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/ecf8e07845fac84ee2d416a0815515e55ad313e2.jpg[/img]
[h1]【Story Rich】[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/986280/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/766280/

notes.title: English Demo Version Now in Development
notes.content:
Greetings fellow players,

Thank you for your support for Koi Musubi.
The sales are far beyond our expectation,  and we've received many positive feedbacks.

Many of these feedbacks (especially those from the players in English speaking regions) have been asking for an English version of Koi Musubi.

Thus, we've decided to start working on an English Demo, which will include the prologue with more than 10,000 words context.

We'll check on the feedbacks about this demo version,and seek the assistance of localization professionals to see if a complete English version is a viable option.

We are looking forward to deliver this demo to you as soon as possible.

- "7 Days with Death" Now in Greenlight

One of Narrator's previous works: 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=878835989]7 Days with Death[/url] is now in Steam Greenlight.
It would be greatly helpful for us to bring mores games to Steam if you would vote for "7 Days with Death" to pass the Greenlight.

notes.title: Update notice
notes.content:
Hello players

In order to solve some of the game engine and steam system conflict.
This change is relatively large, but is expected to solve the following problems:

1. You can use the cloud storage file.
2. Optimize the code for the confirmation box to reduce the chances of crash.
3. Fix typo, Simplified Chinese to adjust a small part of the language.

Can not enter the game, if the correct display LOGO,
The AVI XVID encoder is not installed.
Please install AVI XVID code to normal execution.

notes.content:
